verdict.rationale: Jan emphasizes local-first operation ('Privacy First: Everything runs locally when you want it to', 'Personal Intelligence that answers only to you', 'full control and privacy'), which inherently keeps data off vendor training pipelines when using local models. However, there is no explicit policy statement about data usage/training when using cloud-integrated models (OpenAI, Claude, etc.), which the product also supports. Missing for 10: explicit no-training data policy/documentation, terms clarifying cloud-provider data handling, independent privacy audit or community confirmation.
